findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uxgen_render, uxgen_packshot · Private data: uxgen_theme, uxgen_audit, uxgen_status, uxgen_publier · Public sink: uxgen_render, uxgen_audit, uxgen_packshot, uxgen_publier · Destructive: uxgen_theme, uxgen_ameliorer, uxgen_status, uxgen_packshot, uxgen_seo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uxgen_render, uxgen_packshot · Private data: uxgen_theme, uxgen_audit, uxgen_status, uxgen_publier · Public sink: uxgen_render, uxgen_audit, uxgen_packshot, uxgen_publier · Destructive: uxgen_theme, uxgen_ameliorer, uxgen_status, uxgen_packshot, uxgen_seo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
